ceiling_note: Descriptive in-sample bound on deterministic symptom-only prediction, not validation or a clinical statistic.

excluded_features.risk_level: A deterministic disease-level mapping; unavailable before the prediction.
excluded_features.outcome_variable: An outcome with undocumented timing; not known at symptom entry.
excluded_features.age_scaled: Precomputed using undocumented fit data; duplicates age.
excluded_features.bp_scaled: Precomputed using undocumented fit data; duplicates blood_pressure.
excluded_features.chol_scaled: Precomputed using undocumented fit data; duplicates cholesterol_level.
excluded_features.age: Not entered by the symptom-only interface; used only for duplicate grouping.
excluded_features.gender: Not entered by the symptom-only interface; used only for duplicate grouping.
excluded_features.blood_pressure: Not entered by the symptom-only interface; used only for duplicate grouping.
excluded_features.cholesterol_level: Not entered by the symptom-only interface; used only for duplicate grouping.

grouping_note: Group key hashes the 8 raw pre-outcome fields, without the target. No patient ID, time, site or clinical provenance was supplied. Independence cannot be verified.
scope_note: A predefined minimum of 5 distinct raw profiles per original label defines this small study. No Other class and no guessed alias merges. Out-of-scope conditions cannot be detected by the model.
